name: cyber-nexa-solution
description: Cyber Nexa Solution — corporate website, CMS, CRM-style inquiry management and admin platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
